text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"more varied sentence structures and longer connected arguments","quality":"syntactic control","description":"Uses more controlled sentence patterns and sentence linking to build multi-sentence points rather than relying on one simple idea after another."},{"evidence":"examples of teachers, staff, business companies, and students","quality":"development of ideas","description":"Expands the response with multiple supporting points and illustrations instead of repeating the same claim."},{"evidence":"\"However, teacher's opinion matter too\" and \"My school should not follow this model\"","quality":"organizational structure","description":"Presents a clearer argumentative progression with a counterpoint and conclusion that guide the reader through the essay."},{"evidence":"\"don't agree,\" \"might not even agree,\" \"fair decision for everyone\"","quality":"rhetorical awareness","description":"Shows stronger awareness of audience and persuasion by addressing different groups affected by the issue."},{"evidence":"\"disavantages,\" \"consideration,\" \"adaptation\"","quality":"word choice","description":"Uses a somewhat wider and more academic vocabulary range to discuss the topic."}]}
